app.title: Fast-Anything: Don't rewrite it in Rust. Rewrite the 5% that's slow
app.description: A Rust library that identifies and rewrites the 5% of code that is slow, allowing developers to keep most of their code in high-level languages while optimizing critical sections.

proposed_tests.name: Benchmark slow function before and after optimization
Verify API compatibility with existing Rust code
